summary: Practise adaptive governance, Scrum reviews, Kanban flow, and project forecasting. Explore the five-day course and its applied deliverables.
lede: Adaptive project management training helps project managers and delivery leads steer work as requirements and dependencies change. It is also suited to business analysts and product owners who need to connect reprioritisation with governance and accountability. Participants assess uncertainty with Cynefin, clarify decision rights, manage Kanban flow, and use Scrum reviews and burnup trends to guide scope, quality and delivery decisions; workshops develop change logs, quality checklists and an integrated adaptive delivery plan.
audienceIntro: If your project work needs frequent reprioritisation while sponsors still expect clear governance, this course addresses the decisions and artefacts that connect adaptive delivery to project accountability.
prerequisites: Prior experience working on projects or in a project delivery role is expected. Familiarity with basic project planning and team delivery practices will help you apply the exercises; coding is not required.
